description.en: Plan, script, edit and measure your videos, shorts and podcasts, from idea to weekly stats review.
description.fr: Planifiez, écrivez, montez et mesurez vos vidéos, shorts et podcasts, de l'idée au bilan hebdo.

crons.name: Weekly stats review
crons.prompt: Write last week's content review for the channels listed in the stats topic memory: per platform, views, watch time or average view duration, retention, CTR, follower change, and the 3 best and 3 worst posts compared with the week before and with the goals in memory. End with at most 3 concrete ideas for this week. Use the API keys noted in memory (e.g. YOUTUBE_API_KEY, INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN); if no key is set up and no new export was added, report it in one line and stop.
